questions.question: What are the procedures for balancing an account? / [CO2]
questions.solution_html: • Following is the procedure of balancing an account: i. Find out the total of debit side and total of credit side and identify the higher total. ii. Ascertain the difference between total of debit side and total of credit side. iii. If the debit total is more than credit total, put the difference on credit side as ‘By balance c/d’; otherwise on debit side as To balance c/d. iv. Close the account by writing total amount on both sides. v. Put the debit balance on the debit side of the account and write ‘To Balance b/d’ otherwise on credit side and write ‘By balance b/d’. ( If the process is explained using imaginary figures too, award full marks)
